department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: Fall 2027 PhD priority date is January 15, 2027; the international deadline is May 1, 2027 and the final deadline June 15, 2027.

gre_general.value: The GRE requirement is waived for the department's programs at this time.
gre_general.quote: The GRE requirement has been waived for our programs at this time.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the department pages checked

supervisor.value: Identifying an ECE faculty advisor before applying is not required but strongly encouraged; otherwise you must find one in the first year.
supervisor.quote: Identifying a faculty advisor from the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering prior to applying is not required; however, it is strongly encouraged.

funding.value: PhD students may receive RA, TA or GA support with a tuition scholarship, and funding is typically prioritized for PhD students.
funding.quote: PhD students may receive Research Assistant (RA), Teaching Assistant (TA), or Graduate Assistant (GA) support. All students with an assistantship receive a Graduate Tuition Scholarship. Funding is typically prioritized for PhD students.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree in electrical or computer engineering or computer science is the stated minimum for graduate study.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor’s degree in electrical or computer engineering or computer science from an accredited college or university.

notes: Covers PhDs in both Electrical Engineering and Computer Engineering.
